origin: Synthetic contract derived from the QA status policy observed in Empath #2430.
prompt: Fix verdict(status, expectedSha). Return PASS, FAIL or BLOCKED only from an AI QA description with that exact verdict token and matching sha. A green transport state alone is UNKNOWN. files.verdict.mjs: export function verdict(status, expectedSha) { return status?.state === 'success' ? 'PASS' : 'FAIL'; }

origin: Synthetic regression for Bulma sibling-path parity lesson.
prompt: Both save and autosave persist an amount. Reject non-integers, zero, negatives, NaN, infinity and non-numbers before any persist call, using one shared validation path. Keep both exports and pass valid integers through unchanged. Add a node test.

files.save.mjs:
export function save(amount,persist) { if(amount<=0) throw Error('invalid'); return persist(amount); }
export function autosave(amount,persist) { return persist(amount); }
